\\Mobile Device Reimbursement Form 3RD QTR FY25.docx 4/3/2025 7:55 PM Page 1 Mobile Device Reimbursement 1 Agreement 2 3 4 PURPOSE 5 6 The purpose of this Agreement is to partially compensate employees of Idaho Public Television (Agency) for appropriate 7 business use of their personal mobile device. 8 9 CONDITIONS AND UNDERSTANDINGS 10 11 • I am free to use the mobile device, service, and terms of my choice, given I maintain a service plan and working 12 device to meet the business needs of this Agreement for the entire duration of its term. 13 • I understand that using my personal mobile device for state business, including e-mail, is my choice. 14 • I understand that business-related E-mail(s) and/or texts on my personal mobile device are considered public 15 records and are subject to the same laws as any other public records. 16 • My personal mobile device and service may include voice, data, and other mobile features and applications. 17 • My personal mobile device must be used in compliance with Idaho’s state mobile device policies 18 (https://ita.idaho.gov/resources/). 19 • I will protect my mobile device to the best of my ability to help ensure state information is protected. 20 • I understand that, if my mobile device is lost or stolen, it must be remotely wiped of all information since 21 otherwise it may expose sensitive state information to theft or exploitation. 22 • I agree that I will not dispose of my mobile device, return it to my provider, or give it to another individual 23 without ensuring that my agency’s IT shop has had a chance to wipe any sensitive state information. 24 • I agree to always use a secure PIN or password to help protect the information on my mobile device and to 25 prevent unauthorized use of my mobile device. 26 • I agree to notify my direct supervisor, my division director, and my agency’s mobile device manager 27 immediately upon realizing that my mobile device has been stolen or irretrievably lost. 28 • I agree to not access my agency’s or another entity’s Classification 3 (Restricted) type data from my personal 29 mobile device (See Idaho Technology Authority (ITA) G540 – Mobile Devices Guidelines). 30 o An example of Classification 3 data is personally identifiable information or PII. PII includes 31 information that “alone or in combination, is linked or linkable to a specific person that would allow a 32 reasonable person in the community, who does not have personal knowledge of the relevant 33 circumstances, to identify the person with reasonable certainty”. (Idaho Code: 33-133(h)) 34 o For this agreement, Credit Card information is considered Classification 3 data or higher. 35 o An employee who has business reasons to utilize a mobile device and to access Classification 3 or 36 higher data must utilize a state-owned mobile device and must have a mobile device management 37 client installed on the device. 38 • Idaho Public Television is not responsible for any overage fees, service fees, equipment replacement costs, 39 payment of the employee’s personal service plan/invoice(s), or any other related costs of the employee’s 40 personal mobile device or mobile device service. 41 • The reimbursement may not exceed the amount paid by the employee for related services. 42
